title: Become a Claude power user with this $20 E-Degree
excerpt: Make Claude work smarter for you with this online training deal.
content_html:
TL;DR: Stop underutilizing Claude and unlock its full potential with some help from the Claude AI Professional E-Degree, on sale now for just $19.99 (reg. $159).

Credit: Eduonix Learning Solutions

$19.99
$159 Save $139.01

Learning to use AI efficiently is becoming increasingly important, whether you’re working on personal projects or trying to incorporate it into your workflow. The Claude AI Professional E-Degree gives you a structured way to master one of the most popular AI models, with lessons on prompting, coding, and integrations to help you put your knowledge into practice.

Right now, you can secure the Claude AI Professional E-Degree for just $19.99.

When it comes to AI, you don’t want to miss the boat. The Claude AI Professional E-Degree lets you keep up without having to head back to school or spend hours doing your own research. This 8-hour E-Degree shows you how it works, how to prompt, how to use it for coding and integrations, and a whole lot more.

The Claude AI Professional E-Degree is taught by Eduonix Learning Solutions, a professional team of technology trainers who teach you how to use these skills the way they’re used in the real world.

Recommended deals for you

The Apple iPhone 18 Pro is free right now with T-Mobile

You can work through the four hands-on modules at your own pace and go from a Claude beginner to an expert user. Start with Claude Chat: Best Practices, where you learn how to craft the most effective prompts and achieve the best results. From there, you move on to Claude Code: Agentic Coding, which helps you become a more efficient coder.

A Claude CoWork module shows you how to connect Claude with your favorite apps and plugins to streamline your daily routines. Then the Master Claude CoWork module takes things even further, showing you more advanced plugins and automation to help build a better AI-driven workflow.

There are quizzes available to test your retention as you go. You’ll also receive a professional E-Degree certification upon completion of the modules.
